# id: PG-pg-52-balance-weapon-smithing
# covers: PG 188 (+ 145/229 data: the Sickle) (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 7D80DBB3 (JobOperateScaling on), harness 08AB6BF0; set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: 11 windows of 10 game min at speed 10: skill 10/90 without gear, then 3 x (skill 50: no gear / +50% weapon_smithing / +50% Labouring control).
#   10 Sickle crafts are queued before every window; result = queue drop in the window (a drop of 10 = saturated:
#   tell the PG agent to shorten the window). The gear is an Iron Hat given to and worn by the worker.
# verify: every window has a BAL line with queue values; at least one craft per no-gear window at skill 50 (else the
#   window is too short: tell the PG agent). Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv, then
#   tools/analyze_balance.py. lab50 should equal none (else Labouring leaks into this job); own50 > none means the job
#   reads the hooked weapon_smithing.
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Beaks
research "Basic Weapon Smithing"
research "Basic Weapon Grades"
research "Utility Weapons"
benches 400 crafts ~ Weapon[^|]*Sickle
clearjobs Avarek
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- w1: skill 10, gear none, repeat 1 ---
setstat Avarek weapon_smith 10
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
give Avarek "Iron Plates" 15
craft Avarek "Sickle" at "Weapon" count 10 ~ queued
@set Q0 benches 400 ~ Weapon[^|]*queue=(\d+)
speed 10
@wait-game 10 900
speed 0
@set Q1 benches 400 ~ Weapon[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@echo BAL,188,weapon_smithing,10,0,600,${Q0},${Q1},none,w1
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w2: skill 90, gear none, repeat 1 ---
setstat Avarek weapon_smith 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
give Avarek "Iron Plates" 15
craft Avarek "Sickle" at "Weapon" count 10 ~ queued
@set Q0 benches 400 ~ Weapon[^|]*queue=(\d+)
speed 10
@wait-game 10 900
speed 0
@set Q1 benches 400 ~ Weapon[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@echo BAL,188,weapon_smithing,90,0,600,${Q0},${Q1},none,w2
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w3: skill 50, gear none, repeat 1 ---
setstat Avarek weapon_smith 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
give Avarek "Iron Plates" 15
craft Avarek "Sickle" at "Weapon" count 10 ~ queued
@set Q0 benches 400 ~ Weapon[^|]*queue=(\d+)
speed 10
@wait-game 10 900
speed 0
@set Q1 benches 400 ~ Weapon[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@echo BAL,188,weapon_smithing,50,0,600,${Q0},${Q1},none,w3
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w4: skill 50, gear own50, repeat 1 ---
setstat Avarek weapon_smith 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" weapon_smithing 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek weapon_smithing ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
give Avarek "Iron Plates" 15
craft Avarek "Sickle" at "Weapon" count 10 ~ queued
@set Q0 benches 400 ~ Weapon[^|]*queue=(\d+)
speed 10
@wait-game 10 900
speed 0
@set Q1 benches 400 ~ Weapon[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@echo BAL,188,weapon_smithing,50,50,600,${Q0},${Q1},own50,w4
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w5: skill 50, gear lab50, repeat 1 ---
setstat Avarek weapon_smith 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" labouring 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek labouring ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
give Avarek "Iron Plates" 15
craft Avarek "Sickle" at "Weapon" count 10 ~ queued
@set Q0 benches 400 ~ Weapon[^|]*queue=(\d+)
speed 10
@wait-game 10 900
speed 0
@set Q1 benches 400 ~ Weapon[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@echo BAL,188,weapon_smithing,50,0,600,${Q0},${Q1},lab50,w5
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w6: skill 50, gear none, repeat 2 ---
setstat Avarek weapon_smith 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
give Avarek "Iron Plates" 15
craft Avarek "Sickle" at "Weapon" count 10 ~ queued
@set Q0 benches 400 ~ Weapon[^|]*queue=(\d+)
speed 10
@wait-game 10 900
speed 0
@set Q1 benches 400 ~ Weapon[^|]*queue=(\d+)
